Title: Rajesh and the Family

Cast

1. Rajesh - 28 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Sonali - 55 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Nitin - 34 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Hema - 29 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
5. Pallavi - 26 years, friend
Look: green saree

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The metro platform - a shining floor, a display board
4. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Rajesh stands in the kitchen. Sonali, Nitin and Hema stand near him.]

Hema: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rajesh cuts his finger while chopping onions and it starts to bleed.]

Nitin (happily): "What next?"

[The knife slips and Rajesh's hand is cut; blood drips onto the floor.]

Rajesh: "Hema, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Sonali: "Let's begin."

[Rajesh pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Rajesh (happily): "This is amazing!"

[Rajesh sips red wine.]

Hema: "That's easy."

[Rajesh walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Sonali: "Hema, look at this."

[Rajesh presses a cloth to the wound to stop the bleeding.]

Sonali: "Yes, of course."

[Rajesh nearly dies laughing at the joke.]

Rajesh (excited): "That was fun!"

[Rajesh laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Rajesh: "Really?"

Scene 3: The metro platform - Day

Sonali: "Let's begin."

[Rajesh runs to catch the train.]

Rajesh: "One more time!"

[Rajesh is pushed in the crowd and nearly falls.]

Sonali (softly): "This is amazing!"

[Rajesh offers his seat to an old woman.]

Sonali: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 4: The hospital ward - Day

[Rajesh is asleep in bed in the ward. Sonali, Nitin and Hema stand near him.]

Hema: "Let's begin."

[After a long illness Rajesh passes away in his hospital bed.]

Sonali (laughing): "We have to be strong now."
